title: The Crucible
why: The Salem witch trials open on 1 March 1692, the day Tituba, Sarah Good and Sarah Osborne were first examined.

title: Straight Outta Compton
why: The Rodney King beating of 3 March 1991 detonates in the middle of the film, and the verdict burns the end of it.

title: The Death of Stalin
why: Stalin's stroke and death, 2–5 March 1953, played as farce — the corpse is the plot.

title: The Alamo
why: The final assault on the Alamo at dawn on 6 March 1836, after a thirteen-day siege.

title: Selma
why: Bloody Sunday on the Edmund Pettus Bridge, 7 March 1965 — the film's shattering centrepiece.

title: Notorious
why: The drive-by that killed Christopher Wallace in Los Angeles, 9 March 1997.

title: The Story of Alexander Graham Bell
why: 'Mr. Watson, come here, I want to see you' — the first telephone call, 10 March 1876.

title: Fukushima 50
why: The Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami hit at 14:46 on 11 March 2011; the film stays inside Daiichi from that minute.

title: The Sound of Music
why: The Anschluss of 12 March 1938 is what turns a governess musical into an escape film — the swastika drops over the von Trapp gate.

title: Schindler's List
why: The liquidation of the Kraków ghetto, 13 March 1943 — the girl in the red coat.

title: Pi
why: Pi Day, 3/14. Max Cohen's hunt for the number underneath everything.
alt: Einstein born 14 March 1879; Marx died 14 March 1883

title: The Ides of March
why: The title is the date: 15 March, the day Caesar was warned about and Clooney's campaign learns the same lesson.
alt: Julius Caesar (1953) — the assassination itself, 44 BC

title: The Boondock Saints
why: Opens on St Patrick's Day in South Boston, 17 March — Mass, then the bar fight that starts everything.
alt: The Departed; Darby O'Gill and the Little People

title: The Age of Pioneers
why: Alexei Leonov leaves Voskhod 2 for the first spacewalk on 18 March 1965, and can't get back in.

title: Green Zone
why: Opens with the shock-and-awe bombardment of Baghdad that began on 19 March 2003.

title: The Purge
why: Sirens at 7pm on 21 March; all crime legal until 7am on the 22nd. The date is on screen.

title: The Breakfast Club
why: Brian's essay is dated on screen: Saturday, March 24, 1984, Shermer High School, Shermer, Illinois.

title: The Great Escape
why: Seventy-six men out of Stalag Luft III on the moonless night of 24/25 March 1944.
alt: The Triangle Shirtwaist fire, 25 March 1911; The Lord of the Rings — the Ring goes into the fire on 25 March

title: The China Syndrome
why: Three Mile Island partially melted down on 28 March 1979 — twelve days after this film opened, and almost exactly as scripted.

title: Loving Vincent
why: Van Gogh was born on 30 March 1853; the film is painted in his own hand, frame by frame.
alt: Reagan shot outside the Hilton, 30 March 1981

title: Selena
why: Selena Quintanilla-Pérez was shot at the Days Inn in Corpus Christi on 31 March 1995.
